digest.lead: A quiet day in the Claude ecosystem with a routine Claude Code maintenance update being the only fresh development.
digest.summary: The main activity was a minor Claude Code CLI update with bug fixes and reliability improvements.

stories.headline: Claude Code CLI Receives Minor Bug Fix Update
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.168 was released today with bug fixes and reliability improvements [1]. The update appears to be a routine maintenance release focused on stability rather than new features.
stories.impact: Developers using Claude Code daily should see improved stability and fewer edge-case issues in their coding workflows.

stories.headline: Use case-insensitive agent type names in Claude Code configurations
stories.summary: Claude Code now accepts agent type names with any casing and separators. This makes configuration more flexible and reduces errors from formatting inconsistencies.
actionable_steps: In your Claude Code configuration, use any casing for agent types (e.g., 'Code Reviewer', 'code-reviewer', 'CODE_REVIEWER')
Test that your existing configurations still work with the new flexible matching
Update documentation to reflect the more flexible naming convention

stories.headline: Use `/tui fullscreen` for flicker-free Claude Code rendering
stories.summary: The `/tui fullscreen` command switches Claude Code to a flicker-free rendering mode within the same conversation. This improves visual stability and reduces screen flicker during interactions.
actionable_steps: Press Enter to activate flicker-free rendering mode

stories.headline: Use `/terminal-setup` to configure smoother fullscreen scrolling in VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.116 improved terminal scrolling performance by automatically configuring your editor's scroll sensitivity. This eliminates choppy scrolling when working in fullscreen terminal mode.
actionable_steps: Open Claude Code in your VS Code, Cursor, or Windsurf editor
Allow Claude Code to configure your editor's scroll sensitivity settings

stories.headline: Configure streaming timeout for better connection handling
stories.summary: The new CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS environment variable lets you customize how long Claude Code waits before timing out idle streaming connections. This helps prevent unnecessary disconnections during long-running operations.
actionable_steps: Choose a timeout value in milliseconds (default is 90000 for 90 seconds)
Restart Claude Code for the setting to take effect

stories.headline: Set up hooks to automate Claude Code workflows at key events
stories.summary: Hooks allow you to run custom scripts or commands automatically when specific events occur in Claude Code, such as session start, prompt submission, or instruction loading. This enables automated setup, validation, or custom integrations.
actionable_steps: Create hook configuration files in your project's .claude directory
Define hook events (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, etc.) and their corresponding actions
Configure hook handlers with command, HTTP, or MCP tool fields as needed
Test hooks using the /hooks menu to verify they trigger correctly
